wu: Alphabet Relay: Divide class into 2 teams. One student runs to the board, writes a letter U-Z, next student writes the next, etc. First team to write all letters wins. They cheer 'U-V-W, we are the best!'
wuAlt: Letter Sound Jump: Teacher calls 'Jump for U!' kids jump and say /uː/. Fast-paced review.
Alphabet Chain: Each student says one letter + sound, e.g., 'U is for umbrella, /uː/'.
pres: Show flashcards U-Z with pictures. Drill sounds: 'U is for umbrella, /uː/'. Model dictionary use: 'Look at guide words: Umbrella-zebra. Find umbrella!' Students point to the page.
presAlt: Storytime: Read a short story with U-Z words, e.g., 'The unicorn saw a xylophone.' Kids repeat the words.
Alphabet Poster: Add U-Z letters to a class poster, each student draws one word.
prac: Pair Dictation: Student A says a U-Z word, Student B writes the letter. Swap. Check with a code: Teacher shows flashcards, kids say the sound and letter.
pracAlt: Alphabet Order Race: Give mixed U-Z cards. Pairs sort them fastest. Say 'U comes before V!'
Find the Word: Teacher calls 'Find umbrella!' Kids point in their picture dictionaries.
ls: Listen and Circle: Play audio of U-Z words. Kids circle the correct word in their picture dictionaries. Check answers as a class.
re: Alphabet Dance: Play the alphabet song. Kids dance and freeze when the music stops. Teacher calls a letter, e.g., 'Freeze on V!'
prod: My Dictionary Page: Each student creates a page for 2 letters U-Z. Draw 3 pictures, write the words. Present to their group: 'This is V for violin.'
rw: Trace and Write: Students trace U-Z letters in their notebooks. Write 2 sentences: 'U is for umbrella. V is for violin.'
st: Sing the Alphabet Song: Full class with actions. End with goodbye routine: Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line.
g: Teams race to write U-Z letters on the board.
Teacher calls a letter, kids jump and say the sound.
Kids point to U-Z words in their picture dictionaries.
Teacher describes a U-Z word, kids find it.
diff: Fast finishers: Write a sentence for each U-Z letter, e.g., 'U is for umbrella, it is blue.'
Support: Trace letters with dotted lines, use alphabet posters for reference.
hw: Write 4 sentences about phonics using and/but, e.g., 'U is for umbrella and V is for violin.'
Draw 5 U-Z words and label them.
Sing the alphabet song to your family.
tip: Use the American Space Oujda's picture dictionaries with local images (e.g., 'zebra' in a Moroccan context) to boost engagement and cultural relevance.
